info.title: Maya Teaching Platform API
info.description: Demo v0.1 platform contract. Supplier identity appears only in the teacher-only ProviderDataCallV1 disclosure. Model names, external resource IDs, API keys, absolute file paths, and prepared turn text are never public fields.

UpdateAgentMetadataRequest.description:
CAS payload for mutable Agent metadata and owner-controlled visibility.

``description`` is intentionally nullable on the wire so clients can
clear an older/null value explicitly.  The database stores a non-null
empty string.
UpdateAgentMetadataRequest.title: UpdateAgentMetadataRequest

DebateLLMParams.title: DebateLLMParams

topic.description: Non-empty topic; any script or symbols are accepted.

turn_protocol.description: New debates use the four-round teaching protocol with paragraph output.

safe_error_code.description: The server-authored code for why that turn would not generate.

PersonaSpecV2.description:
Canonical stored schema for the five-section Persona template.

V2 intentionally has no ``debate_strategy`` or ``boundaries`` fields.
Platform rules and debate scheduling remain server-owned, so retaining
those headings as empty compatibility values would misrepresent authorship
and make the new schema indistinguishable from a legacy V1 projection.

reply_text.description: Anonymous classroom message from the frozen Final input addressed by reply_to.

prepared_turns.description: Turns already generated, including a draft warming in the background.

expected_turns.description: Turns this debate's plan contains, from its own agent and round counts.

stall.description: The turn that stopped this draft warming, if one did. Background warming halts at the first turn that will not generate and changes no status, so without this a stalled draft is indistinguishable from one still thinking. Read from that turn, never stored.

next_turn_ready.description: Derived readiness of the adjacent live or retained replay successor while playing, paused, or waiting_next; Next may interrupt the current published speech.
